title: FOwOxxy's (MrPazzHbIu's) Mod
description: That's a little mod that adds some features to your Minecraft world such as new blocks, tool etc.
body:
Hello there!

Do you want improve your Minecraft world? Don't worry! There is some features to do it!

## What this mod adds?

- New ore and blocks
- New structures
- New tools

# 

**New ore!**

You can find a new ore named _Dozaryte_ only at level Y<0 (Yes, you'll can't find stone variant of ore)

![New ore has a green color, 5 dots on deepslate looks like a dots on dice and it ore emmites a light](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c1217ea12e1a483c875a265b22a767b85683ec8_0.webp)

# 

**New items from new ore**

Here you can see _Raw Dozaryte_ from the right and its variant after furnace (just a _Dozaryte_) from the left.

![Raw Dozaryte looks like a dark-green blob, Dozaryte looks like a 3 green tiny stones](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a95a9de41c2413ec4457341453c49239a508b68d_0.webp)

And **SAFE** variant of it - _Dozaryte Cube_. Just use Netherite Ingot, Diamonds and Dozaryte

![Looks like a green cube in 2D that "emmites" a light from the center](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fcae9eb10f6d9912b4c9a02c27692b3bd00cd30_0.webp)

# 

**New blocks!**

Meet the blocks from new ore with their recipes!

![Raw Dozaryte Block looks like blocks of Raw Iron or Gold, but green, Dozaryte Block looks like a Diamond Block, but green](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/392a93202e6ca8197b05f4f78ee2d8dfc29cf8f9.png)

**Please, DON'T TOUCH IT WITH BARE HANDS AND DON'T STEP ON IT!**

#

**New structures!**

**Desert Pillager Outpost**

Wow, it seems, pillagers placed a **POWERFUL** base into the desert! Can you challenge it for unique rewards?
Remember, every dungeon is also unique!

![Desert Pillager Outpost looks like a big sandstone castle in the desert with the main entrance to which Minecraft randomly attaches various structures. These can be various corridors, turns, towers, dead ends, stairs etc.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5815da96705e05ef9459a7ebfd41a29bc637e3e_0.webp)

#

**The Grave**

Guests from the other world left us a gift! It seems, they were very unhappy! It's just a grave, JUST A GRAVE, right?

![The Grave consists of deepslate bricks.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af7ac0edcee9ea6aa9892863ee268cbe74089981.png)

#

**The well**

You can find it everywhere at your Minecraft world! What a tresures are hidden in?

![The well consists of base that consists of stone bricks. The well might have a wooden or stone roof. At the bottom you can find a chest with treasure if you'll be lucky.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb3b5511ae012b08b7d4df1c06e1f8db96ad230a.png)

#

**New item!**

**Glasscutter**

No more Silk Touch for a Glass! Let's go!

![Glasscutter looks like a metal disk on a stick](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/238c94a8d138a068815e371edf18017cc7678913_0.webp)

#

Well, it's all. If you want see more, just download this mod for NeoForge 1.12.4!
Enjoy!
